headers.title: Header Defaults
headers.description: Default headers for Claude and Codex OAuth requests when the client omits them
headers.stabilize_device_desc: Pin OS/Arch and stabilize the software fingerprint per credential/API key
headers.codex_identity_confuse_desc: When fill-first routing or session affinity is used, remap Codex prompt_cache_key and installation identity for the selected auth
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_desc: Manage the Core LTS retry guard for Codex OAuth responses with abnormal reasoning token counts
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_summary_d: Switches, retry action, and delivery behavior are separated so the effective guard state is easier to verify.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_group_swi: Decide whether the strategy is active, whether streaming output is buffered, and whether a second request lane can be used.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_group_ret: Configure the matched action, buffer cap, second-lane delay, and hedged return mode.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_group_mat: Limit matching by model, reasoning effort, abnormal reasoning token count, and retry budget.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_group_del: Control exhausted behavior, client-visible usage, and candidate response selection.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_group_sco: Restrict the strategy by auth kind or auth ID so unrelated credentials are not affected.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_enabled_d: Shortcut for retry/disabled; use Action for observe-only mode
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_action_hi: retry discards matching responses and retries; observe-only records matches without retry; disabled leaves responses unchanged
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_action_re: Matching responses are discarded and retried until the retry limit is reached.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_action_ob: Matches are recorded only. The response delivered to the client is not changed.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_action_di: The abnormal reasoning guard is disabled. Matching conditions do not affect delivery.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_stream_bu: Hold streaming chunks until response.completed so matching abnormal responses can be retried transparently
0 means unlimited buffering; positive values flush and fall back to pass-through for the current stream once exceeded
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_hedged_re: After the first abnormal response is discarded, launch a delayed second lane to reduce tail latency
Quality waits for dispatched lanes; speed returns the first successful lane. Delivery policy selects among completed candidates.
Wait for dispatched lanes and choose the steadier result using the delivery policy.
Return as soon as the first deliverable lane succeeds, trading some certainty for lower latency.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_hedge_del: Delay before starting the second lane after an abnormal attempt has triggered retry
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_require_d: Prefer a different auth ID for the hedged second lane
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_model_con: Matches when the requested or resolved upstream model contains any value
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_reasoning: Optional translated Codex reasoning.effort values such as high or xhigh; leave empty to match any effort
Non-negative integer token counts that trigger retry
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_max_retri: Maximum extra retries caused by abnormal reasoning detection; 0 records the failed attempt and returns 502 without retry
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_exhausted: Choose what Core returns after abnormal retry attempts exceed the max retries limit
After the retry limit is reached, return 502 instead of delivering the abnormal response.
After the retry limit is reached, deliver the last abnormal response so the request can still complete.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_client_us: Controls client-visible token aggregation only; Management usage keeps per-attempt accounting.
The client sees usage from the delivered response only. Management usage still records every real attempt.
The client sees usage fields summed across all attempts.
Detail fields are summed, but total remains from the delivered response for clients that read only total.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_delivery_: Used only when candidates include both special and non-special responses
Deliver the first successful normal response to reduce waiting.
Deliver the candidate with the largest output.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_fallback_: Used when every candidate is special after retries are exhausted
When only abnormal candidates remain, choose the highest-quality abnormal response.
When only abnormal candidates remain, choose the abnormal response with the largest output.
When only abnormal candidates remain, choose the latest completed abnormal response.
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_auth_kind: Normalized auth kind whitelist; default OAuth does not match API keys
headers.codex_abnormal_reasoning_retry_auth_ids_: Optional exact auth ID whitelist; leave empty to match all IDs
